item.title: EplayerX 1.2.47
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 暂停或继续播放时，已隐藏的播放控制栏保持隐藏，移动鼠标即可重新显示。 - 改善播放器 2 在续播下一集、跳转及切换音轨时的画面衔接，减少旧画面停留和黑屏。 - 修正画面文字扫描的正则表达式错误提示。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Hidden playback controls now stay hidden when pausing or resuming. Move the pointer to show them again. - Improved Player 2 frame transitions when starting the next episode, seeking, and switching audio tracks, reducing stale frames and black flashes. - Corrected the regular-expression validation message for on-screen text scanning.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
